attributes.location: grain boundaries or inner the grains of gamma phases

evidence.quote: besides γ + γ’ phases, there were bright blocky borides precipitated on the grain boundaries or inner the grains of γ phases in the diffusion affected zone (DAZ)

attributes.size: nanoparticles with a diameter of 45 nm

evidence.quote: And inside the γ grains, there were a large amount of round second γ’ phases with a diameter of 45 nm precipitated.
It can be seen that bright phase B in ASZ was cubic crystal structure, and the person symbol was cP 8. HAADF-EDS results in Fig. 5 e demonstrate it was supposed to be IMC of AlPd
the dark blocky phase C in ASZ was rich in Cr and B ( Table 2 ), and the SAED pattern and IFFT image demonstrate it was the Cr 5 B 3 borides ( Fig. 5 c and d) of tetragonal crystal structure
When bonded for short time of 10 min, as IS of BNi-2 interlayer was insufficient, the brittle Ni-Si-B eutectic phases formed in the ASZ can lead to limited shear strength, about 752 MPa.
Hence, the best property of joint was achieved, around 934 MPa.

With the bonding time prolonged furtherly, enrichment of Al con -centration led to more and larger AlPd compounds, with other products like large Ni 3 Al and Cr 5 B 3 borides formed in the ASZ. And the joint strength decreased to 677 MPa.
After bonding for 120 min, as the volume fraction of eutectic compounds increased furtherly, solidification cracks occurred in the ASZ and the shear strength of joint was lowest, about 502 MPa.
The hardness distribution of joint in Fig. 9 a illustrates the eutectic products were hard and brittle, with a hardness of 15.3 GPa, which was much higher than those of other regions ( < 8 GPa).

evidence.section: 3.2. Effect of bonding time on joint microstructure
evidence.quote: As the eutectic phases were hard and brittle, there were solidification cracks existed in the ASZ due to a big difference of thermal expansion coefficients between the eutectic phase and soft γ matrix
Also, the volume fraction of borides in the DAZ and TBZ were high enough especially the intragranular TiB 2 borides, which can strengthen the joint excellently.
Therefore, three IMCs including Ni 3 (Al, Ti), AlPd and Cr 5 B 3 observed in the ASZ demonstrate there was a eutectic reaction happened in the TLP process: L → γ’ + AlPd + Cr 5 B 3 .
